test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct word for the blanks in the given sentence.**

Venga boys is a famous musical _________ of the country and Madhu gave me a __________ on my birthday.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Band**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, the word "**band**" is appropriate for both blanks.
 
• The first blank refers to "**Venga boys**," which is a famous musical group or ensemble, commonly known as a "**band**."
 
• The second blank refers to the gift Madhu gave, and without additional context, "**band**" is a plausible choice, as people often receive wristbands or watches as gifts, and these items are commonly referred to as "bands."
 
• Grammatically, it is a noun that functions as the object of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence**: *Venga boys is a famous musical band __of the country, and Madhu gave me a __band __on my birthday.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Group **is a broader term that can refer to any collection of people or things, not specifically musicians.
 
• **Troop **is usually used to refer to a group of soldiers or scouts, not musicians.
 
• The word "**ring**" can have various meanings depending on the context, it could be Jewelry, Sound, Circular Objects etc.
